svg.text: 1 Korean: ㅇ is velar nasal syllable-finally only(initial is null); ㄹ is [ɾ] (tap) or [l](lateral) by position; w and y appear only asglides in diphthongs.

2 Sanskrit is placed by Pāṇinian classification,not IPA: र = mūrdhanya (retroflex), स = dantya(dental), ह = kaṇṭhya (velar), व = oṣṭhya(labial). Each engineered tradition files itssounds under its own system.
